applies_why: The judge resolves the clash by whether the cited texts' own words state the contrary, the verse-by-verse stating-verse test the rule retires for chain witnesses.
quote: but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
why: The judge treats the absence of contrary wording in the individual texts as decisive instead of weighing chain against chain by footing as K-C requires.
